title: I allocated $3B to quant hedge funds for years. Today I start building my first strategy with AI tools, LIVE (Day 2)
author: stoaphil
selftext:
I was head PM at an allocator picking mostly quant hedge funds (about $3B AUM), and I'm a CFA charterholder. I've sat through hundreds of quant pitches, so I know what gets hand-waved.

It's just me and AI coding tools. Yesterday I tested a few ideas at a high level and picked a single strategy. Today I start implementing it, narrating how an allocator would pick it apart as I go. No course, nothing to sell.

The stream itself is run by an AI agent too (it handles OBS, health checks and the recording), which is its own rabbit hole.

**LIVE NOW:**

Twitch: [twitch.tv/sudomyshkin](http://twitch.tv/sudomyshkin)

YouTube: [https://youtu.be/GbytTnb\_HHI](https://youtu.be/GbytTnb_HHI)

Questions welcome in chat, especially "that's overfit" ones. Not investment advice, not raising money, just building in public.
